changelog:
Initial release with full Douyin data access via 27 structured endpoints.

- Pull videos, user profiles, feeds, comments, hashtags, music, live rooms, hot-search, and perform keyword search (videos, users, music, live, hashtags).
- All endpoints return structured JSON.
- Includes endpoint summary, pricing (1 credit/endpoint, searches 10 credits), usage examples, and key guardrails.
- Requires a Scavio API key for use. 
- Detailed documentation on identifiers, pagination, and error handling provided.
display_name: Douyin Scraper API - Videos, Creators, Comments, Search
summary: Pull Douyin videos, user profiles and feeds, comments, hashtags, music, live rooms, the hot-search board, and keyword search across videos, users, music, live and hashtags. 27 endpoints, structured JSON.
